% Plain academic document styling for pandoc + xelatex
% Title page uses \@title, \@subtitle, \@author, \@date from YAML frontmatter.

%% Allow URL line breaks at slashes and hyphens — must precede hyperref
\PassOptionsToPackage{hyphens,obeyspaces,spaces}{url}

%% DejaVu covers Greek letters, math symbols (≈), subscripts, and
%% box-drawing characters that Latin Modern lacks.
\usepackage{fontspec}
\setmainfont{DejaVu Serif}
\setsansfont{DejaVu Sans}
\setmonofont{DejaVu Sans Mono}

%% Neutral palette
\usepackage{xcolor}
\definecolor{docslate}{HTML}{1B3A6B}
\definecolor{docaccent}{HTML}{6B7280}
\definecolor{doclightgray}{HTML}{F5F7FA}
\definecolor{docmedgray}{HTML}{D0DCE8}
\definecolor{docdarkgray}{HTML}{4A5568}

%% Page geometry
%% Without this, LaTeX's article defaults give a 345pt (4.77in) column on
%% 8.5in paper -- 3.73in of combined side margin, with the text occupying
%% only 56% of the page width. 1in margins widen the column to 6.5in.
\usepackage[margin=1in]{geometry}
\setlength{\headheight}{14pt}

%% Header and footer
\usepackage{fancyhdr}
\pagestyle{fancy}
\fancyhf{}
\fancyhead[L]{\color{docdarkgray}\small\textit{CMPE 180A \textperiodcentered\ Flight Route Planner}}
\fancyfoot[C]{\color{docdarkgray}\small\thepage}
\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0.4pt}
\renewcommand{\footrulewidth}{0.4pt}
\renewcommand{\headrule}{{\color{docaccent}\hrule width\headwidth height\headrulewidth \vskip-\headrulewidth}}
\renewcommand{\footrule}{{\color{docaccent}\hrule width\headwidth height\footrulewidth \vskip\footrulewidth}}

%% Section heading styles
\usepackage{titlesec}
\titleformat{\section}
  {\color{docslate}\Large\bfseries\sffamily}
  {}{0em}{}
  [\vspace{-2pt}{\color{docaccent}\rule{\linewidth}{1.5pt}}\vspace{2pt}]
\titleformat{\subsection}
  {\color{docslate}\large\bfseries\sffamily}
  {}{0em}{}
\titleformat{\subsubsection}
  {\color{docslate}\normalsize\bfseries\sffamily}
  {}{0em}{}
\titlespacing*{\section}{0pt}{18pt}{6pt}
\titlespacing*{\subsection}{0pt}{12pt}{4pt}
\titlespacing*{\subsubsection}{0pt}{8pt}{2pt}

%% Table styling
\usepackage{booktabs}
\usepackage{colortbl}
\usepackage{array}
\arrayrulecolor{docmedgray}
\setlength{\arrayrulewidth}{0.5pt}
\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.3}

%% Callout boxes (blockquotes → styled callout panels)
\usepackage{mdframed}
\renewenvironment{quote}{%
  \begin{mdframed}[%
    backgroundcolor=doclightgray,%
    linecolor=docaccent,%
    linewidth=3pt,%
    topline=false,%
    rightline=false,%
    bottomline=false,%
    innerleftmargin=14pt,%
    innerrightmargin=10pt,%
    innertopmargin=8pt,%
    innerbottommargin=8pt,%
    skipabove=10pt,%
    skipbelow=6pt%
  ]\small\color{docdarkgray}%
}{%
  \end{mdframed}%
}

%% Code block background
\usepackage{framed}
\definecolor{shadecolor}{HTML}{F3F6F9}

%% Hyperlink colors
\AtBeginDocument{%
  \hypersetup{%
    colorlinks=true,%
    linkcolor=docslate,%
    urlcolor=docaccent,%
    citecolor=docslate,%
    breaklinks=true%
  }%
}

%% Allow overfull hboxes to stretch slightly
\emergencystretch=3em
\setlength{\hfuzz}{2pt}

%% Prevent widows and orphans
\widowpenalty=10000
\clubpenalty=10000

%% Keep sections together (prevent page breaks mid-section)
\usepackage{needspace}
\usepackage{etoolbox}
\preto{\section}{\needspace{5\baselineskip}}
\preto{\subsection}{\needspace{4\baselineskip}}
\preto{\subsubsection}{\needspace{3\baselineskip}}

%% Long table support
\usepackage{longtable}
\usepackage{graphicx}

%% Capture YAML subtitle: field into \@subtitle for the title page.
%% \def is used (not \renewcommand) because \subtitle does not yet exist when
%% --include-in-header runs — pandoc defines \subtitle later in the preamble.
%% \def wins unconditionally; pandoc's subsequent \providecommand becomes a no-op.
\makeatletter
\let\@subtitle\@empty
\def\subtitle#1{\gdef\@subtitle{#1}}
\renewcommand{\maketitle}{%
  \begin{titlepage}
    \centering
    \vspace*{3cm}
    \par\rule{\textwidth}{0.4pt}\par
    \vspace{0.8cm}
    {\huge\bfseries\@title\par}
    \vspace{0.8cm}
    \par\rule{\textwidth}{0.4pt}\par
    \vspace{1.2cm}
    {\Large\@subtitle\par}
    \vspace{0.8cm}
    {\large\@author\par}
    \vspace{0.4cm}
    {\large\@date\par}
    \vfill
  \end{titlepage}%
}
\makeatother
